login.title: Ge ɖe eme
login.text: Ŋlɔ wò telefon xexlẽdzesi. Míaɖo kood si me xexlẽdzesi 6 le ɖe wò le SMS dzi.
login.phoneHint: Xexlẽdzesi si nèzã ŋlɔ wò ŋkɔ ɖe lãmesẽ dɔwɔƒea.
login.unknownNumber: Womeŋlɔ xexlẽdzesi sia abe lãmesẽ dɔwɔla tɔ ene o. Kpɔe ɖa, alo bia wò nutome ɔfis.
login.network: Míete ŋu ɖo sɛva la gbɔ o. Kpɔ wò intanɛt eye nàgate kpɔ.
login.demoText: Zi xexlẽdzesi aɖe dzi be wòayɔ eme. Kood lae nye {{code}}.

patients.title: Dɔnɔwo
patients.search: Di ŋkɔ, kɔƒe alo telefon xexlẽdzesi
patients.empty: Dɔnɔ aɖeke meli haɖe o. Ŋlɔ gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkɔ.
patients.noMatch: Dɔnɔ aɖeke mesɔ kple wò didi o.
patients.notFound: Dɔnɔ sia mele telefon sia dzi o.

patient.noEvidence: Womexɔe ɖe gbe me o: ɖaseɖila aɖe ɖi ɖase.

newPatient.title: Ŋlɔ dɔnɔ ƒe ŋkɔ
newPatient.consentText: Ɖe nusita nèle eƒe nyatakakawo dzram ɖo la gɔme na dɔnɔ la le eƒe gbe me, eye be ate ŋu agbe.
newPatient.consentGiven: Dɔnɔ la lɔ̃ be woadzra eƒe lãmesẽ nyatakakawo ɖo.
newPatient.consentPromise: Eƒe nyatakakawo anɔ telefon sia dzi va se ɖe esime woaɖo wo ɖe lãmesẽ dɔwɔƒea le dedie me. Eƒe lãmesẽ dɔwɔlawo ɖeɖeko akpɔ wo.
newPatient.personText: Ŋlɔ nu si dɔnɔ la gblɔ na wò. Ne menya eƒe dzigbezã o la, ŋlɔ eƒe ƒe.
newPatient.placeText: Ale be lãmesẽ dɔwɔla kple dɔyɔƒe si dze nalé ŋku ɖe eŋu.
newPatient.phoneWhy: Mehiã o. Ɖeko na sraɖekpɔ ŋkuɖodzi.
newPatient.nationalIdWhy: Mehiã o. Ɖeko na NHIS dodokpɔ.
newPatient.statement: Míedi be míadzra wò lãmesẽ ŋuti nuŋlɔɖiwo ɖo fon sia dzi, eye míaɖo wo ɖe Ghana Health Service le mɔ dedie dzi, ale be wò lãmesẽdɔwɔlawo nate ŋu akpɔ wò ɖe ŋu. Wò lãmesẽdɔwɔlawo ɖeɖe koe akpɔe. Àte ŋu agblɔ be ao, eye àte ŋu agblɔ na mí be míadzudzɔ ɣesiaɣi. Èlɔ̃a?

vitals.title: Ŋlɔ dzidzemewo
vitals.referToday: Kplɔ dɔnɔ la yi dɔyɔƒe egbe.
vitals.recheck: Gadzidze le sraɖekpɔ si kplɔe ɖo me eye nàgblɔe na dɔyɔla.
vitals.bodyAdd: Tsɔ kpekpeme kple kɔkɔme kpe ɖe eŋu
vitals.photosHint: Mehiã o. Va se ɖe 3. Dɔnɔ la ƒe dɔyɔyɔ ko ŋuti; bia hafi nàɖee.

appointments.empty_overdue: Naneke ƒe ɣeyiɣi meva yi o. Ayekoo.
appointments.empty_past: Sasrãkpɔ aɖeke mewu enu haɖe o.

sync.title: Ɖo ɖa
sync.allSent: Woɖo nu sia nu si le telefon sia dzi ɖa.

surveillance.title: Nutome ƒe kpuie
surveillance.district: {{district}} · xexlẽme siwo me ŋkɔ mele o
surveillance.demo: Dodokpɔ nyatakakawo va se ɖe esime API la adze dɔwɔwɔ gɔme
surveillance.offline: Kpuie la hiã intanɛt. Gatee kpɔ ne intanɛt va.
surveillance.vsLast: {{diff}} ne wotsɔe sɔ kple ɣeyiɣi si do ŋgɔ
surveillance.partial: Kɔsiɖa aɖewo me dɔnɔwo mede 5 o, eya ta míexlẽ wo o be míakpɔ wo ta.
surveillance.empty: Nyatakaka aɖeke meli na wò nutome haɖe o.
surveillance.allDistricts: Nutome blibowo le kɔsiɖa sia me
surveillance.privacy: Míeɣla xexlẽme siwo mede 5 o be ame aɖeke nagate ŋu adze si dɔnɔ aɖeke o (Act 843 s.24(3)).
surveillance.signalTitle: Lãme xɔxɔ le dzidzim ɖe edzi le {{district}}
surveillance.signalText: Dɔnɔ {{now}} ƒe lãme xɔ le kɔsiɖa si va yi me, gake {{avg}} wònye le kɔsiɖa 4 siwo do ŋgɔ me. Bia nutome ƒe hamea.

profile.photoHint: Wò foto la nɔa telefon sia dzi ɖeɖeko.
profile.photoError: Míete ŋu zã foto ma o. Tia bubu.

pwa.updateText: Gaʋui be nàzãe. Nyatakaka siwo nèdzra ɖo la anɔ telefon sia dzi.
pwa.offlineTitle: HealthConnect wɔa dɔ fifia esime intanɛt meli o
pwa.offlineText: Àte ŋu aʋu app la eye nàŋlɔ dɔnɔwo esime intanɛt meli o.
pwa.installTitle: Tsɔ HealthConnect de wò telefon dzi
pwa.installText: Tsɔe de wò telefon ŋgɔ ale be nàʋui abe app ene.

errors.consent: Ele be dɔnɔ la nalɔ̃ hafi nàdzra eƒe nyatakakawo ɖo.
errors.age: Ŋlɔ ƒe si le 0 kple 120 dome.
errors.range: Nu sia medze abe nyateƒe ene o. Gakpɔ dzidzeme la.
errors.evidence: Xɔ dɔnɔ la ƒe lɔlɔ̃ ɖe gbe me, de asi alo ɖe eƒe foto gbã.

routeError.title: Axa sia meʋu o
routeError.text: Kpɔ wò intanɛt eye nàgatee kpɔ. Nyatakaka siwo nèdzra ɖo le dedie le telefon sia dzi.

registered.title: Woŋlɔ ŋkɔ la!
registered.text: Wodzra nyatakakawo ɖo ɖe telefon sia dzi eye woaɖo wo ɖa ne intanɛt va.

refer.title: Kplɔe yi dɔyɔƒe egbe
refer.text: {{name}} ƒe dzidzemewo fia be ele be wòayi dɔyɔƒe egbe.
refer.tip1: Ɖe nusita wòle be wòayi egbe la gɔme na dɔnɔ la le eƒe gbe me.
refer.tip2: Ne mate ŋu azɔ mɔ o la, yɔ dɔyɔƒe la eye nàgblɔe na dɔyɔla si le dɔ dzi.

capture.spokenHint: Xlẽ nyawo, emegbe xɔ dɔnɔ la ƒe gbe esime wòle ɛ̃ gblɔm. Sekend 30 me.
capture.noMic: Fon sia mate ŋu axɔ gbe o. Na ame bubu si se be dɔnɔ la lɔ̃ la nàŋlɔ eƒe ŋkɔ ɖe ete.
capture.signHint: Dɔnɔ la atsɔ asibide ade asi.
capture.thumbHint: Tsɔ dɔnɔ la ƒe asibidetsu si wosi atike na la ƒo ɖe lɔlɔ̃ agbalẽ la dzi, emegbe ɖe eƒe foto.
capture.photoAlt: Dɔnɔ la ƒe asibidetsu ƒe foto
capture.witnessHint: Mehiã o. Ame bubu si se be dɔnɔ la lɔ̃.
capture.listening: Ele to ɖom… zi edzi nàdzudzɔ
